{{Top|leg}}
[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] served as the head of '''Navy Operations''' aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. Motti held this title prior to and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], which began in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. [[Zi Sturgist]] officially acted as the [[Navy Operations Chief]], but was in reality just an underling of Motti.
